"""Unicode text cleaning for Chinese PDF extraction."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unicodedata


# Kangxi radicals and CJK Radicals Supplement: map each char to its
# standard CJK unified ideograph. Avoid full-text NFKC, which would also
# convert full-width punctuation to half-width.
_RADICAL_RE = re.compile(r"[\u2e80-\u2eff\u2f00-\u2fdf]")

# CJK Radicals Supplement chars with no NFKC decomposition, mapped via the
# "x" equivalences in the Unicode UCD NamesList.txt.
_RADICAL_MAP = {
    0x2E81: 0x20086, 0x2E82: 0x4E5B, 0x2E83: 0x4E5A, 0x2E84: 0x4E59,
    0x2E85: 0x4EBB, 0x2E86: 0x5182, 0x2E87: 0x20628, 0x2E88: 0x2008A,
    0x2E89: 0x5202, 0x2E8A: 0x535C, 0x2E8B: 0x353E, 0x2E8C: 0x5C0F,
    0x2E8D: 0x2D544, 0x2E8E: 0x5140, 0x2E8F: 0x5C23, 0x2E90: 0x5C22,
    0x2E91: 0x21BC2, 0x2E92: 0x5DF3, 0x2E93: 0x5E7A, 0x2E94: 0x5F51,
    0x2E95: 0x2B739, 0x2E96: 0x5FC4, 0x2E97: 0x5FC3, 0x2E98: 0x624C,
    0x2E99: 0x6535, 0x2E9B: 0x65E1, 0x2E9C: 0x65E5, 0x2E9D: 0x6708,
    0x2E9E: 0x6B7A, 0x2EA0: 0x6C11, 0x2EA1: 0x6C35, 0x2EA2: 0x6C3A,
    0x2EA3: 0x706C, 0x2EA4: 0x722B, 0x2EA5: 0x722B, 0x2EA6: 0x4E2C,
    0x2EA7: 0x20092, 0x2EA8: 0x72AD, 0x2EA9: 0x248E9, 0x2EAA: 0x24D14,
    0x2EAB: 0x7F52, 0x2EAC: 0x793A, 0x2EAD: 0x793B, 0x2EAE: 0x25AD7,
    0x2EAF: 0x7CF9, 0x2EB0: 0x7E9F, 0x2EB1: 0x7F53, 0x2EB2: 0x26270,
    0x2EB3: 0x7F51, 0x2EB4: 0x7F51, 0x2EB5: 0x2626B, 0x2EB6: 0x7F8A,
    0x2EB7: 0x2634C, 0x2EB8: 0x2634B, 0x2EB9: 0x8002, 0x2EBA: 0x8080,
    0x2EBB: 0x807F, 0x2EBC: 0x8089, 0x2EBD: 0x26951, 0x2EBE: 0x8279,
    0x2EBF: 0x8279, 0x2EC0: 0x8279, 0x2EC1: 0x864E, 0x2EC2: 0x8864,
    0x2EC3: 0x8980, 0x2EC4: 0x897F, 0x2EC5: 0x89C1, 0x2EC6: 0x89D2,
    0x2EC7: 0x278B2, 0x2EC8: 0x8BA0, 0x2EC9: 0x8D1D, 0x2ECA: 0x27FB7,
    0x2ECB: 0x8F66, 0x2ECC: 0x8FB6, 0x2ECD: 0x8FB6, 0x2ECE: 0x8FB6,
    0x2ECF: 0x9091, 0x2ED0: 0x9485, 0x2ED1: 0x9577, 0x2ED2: 0x9578,
    0x2ED3: 0x957F, 0x2ED4: 0x95E8, 0x2ED5: 0x28E0F, 0x2ED6: 0x961D,
    0x2ED7: 0x96E8, 0x2ED8: 0x9752, 0x2ED9: 0x97E6, 0x2EDA: 0x9875,
    0x2EDB: 0x98CE, 0x2EDC: 0x98DE, 0x2EDD: 0x98DF, 0x2EDE: 0x2967F,
    0x2EDF: 0x98E0, 0x2EE0: 0x9963, 0x2EE1: 0x29810, 0x2EE2: 0x9A6C,
    0x2EE3: 0x9AA8, 0x2EE4: 0x9B3C, 0x2EE5: 0x9C7C, 0x2EE6: 0x9E1F,
    0x2EE7: 0x5364, 0x2EE8: 0x9EA6, 0x2EE9: 0x9EC4, 0x2EEA: 0x9EFE,
    0x2EEB: 0x6589, 0x2EEC: 0x9F50, 0x2EED: 0x6B6F, 0x2EEE: 0x9F7F,
    0x2EEF: 0x9F8D, 0x2EF0: 0x9F99, 0x2EF1: 0x9F9C, 0x2EF2: 0x4E80,
}

# Horizontal whitespace only (no newlines) — a newline between two CJK chars
# is a real line break and must be preserved.
_HSPACE = r"[ \t\u3000]"

_CJK = r"\u4e00-\u9fff\u3400-\u4dbf"

_CJK_SPACE_RE = re.compile(f"([{_CJK}]){_HSPACE}+([{_CJK}])")


def _map_radical_char(ch: str) -> str:
    cur = ch
    for _ in range(3):
        if not _RADICAL_RE.fullmatch(cur):
            break
        if ord(cur) in _RADICAL_MAP:
            cur = chr(_RADICAL_MAP[ord(cur)])
            continue
        mapped = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", cur)
        if mapped == cur:
            break
        cur = mapped
    return cur


def normalize_text(text: str) -> str:
    """Map Kangxi radicals (U+2F00–U+2FDF) and CJK Radicals Supplement
    (U+2E80–U+2EFF) chars to standard CJK. Everything else is unchanged."""
    if not _RADICAL_RE.search(text):
        return text
    return "".join(_map_radical_char(ch) for ch in text)


def clean_extracted_text(text: str) -> str:
    """Clean text extracted from PDF:
    - Map radical-region chars to standard CJK
    - Normalize line endings
    - Remove spaces between adjacent Chinese characters on the same line
    - Collapse multiple blank lines
    """
    text = normalize_text(text)
    text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")

    lines = [line.strip() for line in text.split("\n")]
    text = "\n".join(lines)

    while True:
        new_text = _CJK_SPACE_RE.sub(r"\1\2", text)
        if new_text == text:
            break
        text = new_text

    text = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", text)
    return text.strip()


def strip_footer_page_number(text: str) -> str:
    """Drop a trailing line that is only a page number (e.g. '12')."""
    lines = text.rstrip().split("\n")
    if lines and re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,4}", lines[-1].strip()):
        lines = lines[:-1]
    return "\n".join(lines).rstrip()


def validate_cjk_chars(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return a list of suspicious CJK characters that are not standard CJK
    (Kangxi radicals / CJK radical supplement)."""
    suspicious = []
    for i, ch in enumerate(text):
        cp = ord(ch)
        if 0x2F00 <= cp <= 0x2FD5:
            suspicious.append(f"pos={i} char={ch} U+{cp:04X} (Kangxi radical)")
        elif 0x2E80 <= cp <= 0x2EFF:
            suspicious.append(f"pos={i} char={ch} U+{cp:04X} (CJK radical supplement)")
    return suspicious


def is_mostly_cjk(text: str) -> bool:
    """Check if the text contains a reasonable proportion of CJK characters."""
    if not text:
        return False
    cjk_count = sum(1 for ch in text if _is_cjk(ch))
    return cjk_count > len(text) * 0.1


def _is_cjk(ch: str) -> bool:
    cp = ord(ch)
    return (
        0x4E00 <= cp <= 0x9FFF
        or 0x3400 <= cp <= 0x4DBF
        or 0x20000 <= cp <= 0x2A6DF
        or 0x2A700 <= cp <= 0x2B73F
        or 0xF900 <= cp <= 0xFAFF
    )


_SENTENCE_END_RE = re.compile(r"[。！？；：…\.\!\?\;]$")

# Exam-paper line boundaries: a new question ("3.（10 分）…") or a section
# header ("二、关系数据库设计（共 25 分）") always starts a new block.
_EXAM_QUESTION_START_RE = re.compile(r"\d+\s*[.、．]\s*[（(]\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*分\s*[）)]")
_EXAM_SECTION_START_RE = re.compile(r"^[一二三四五六七八九十]+\s*[、.．]")


def join_exam_lines(text: str) -> str:
    """Join hard line breaks inside an exam paper.

    Unlike a slide page, an exam page has no single title line, so nothing
    is special-cased as a title; instead question headers ("N.（M 分）") and
    section headers ("二、…") always start a new block and are never glued
    to the previous question's text.
    """
    result: list[str] = []
    buf = ""
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            if buf:
                result.append(buf)
                buf = ""
            result.append("")
            continue
        starts_block = (_EXAM_QUESTION_START_RE.match(stripped)
                        or _EXAM_SECTION_START_RE.match(stripped))
        if buf and starts_block:
            result.append(buf)
            buf = ""
        buf = stripped if not buf else _join_pair(buf, stripped)
    if buf:
        result.append(buf)
    return "\n".join(result)


# Short numbered lines like "1. The Atomic Commitment Problem" are section
# headings inside a paper page, not body sentences — they must not be glued
# to neighbouring text when joining hard-wrapped lines.
_HEADING_LINE_RE = re.compile(r"^\d+(\.\d+)*[.、]?\s+\S.{0,80}$")


def _join_pair(buf: str, line: str) -> str:
    """Join two hard-wrapped lines: no space between CJK chars, one space
    whenever either side of the boundary is latin/digit."""
    if buf and line and _is_cjk(buf[-1]) and _is_cjk(line[0]):
        return buf + line
    return buf + " " + line


def join_intra_paragraph_lines(page_text: str) -> str:
    """Join hard line breaks within a paragraph.

    The first line of a page is the title and stays independent. For the
    remaining lines, if a line does NOT end with a sentence-ending
    punctuation mark, it is joined with the next line (no space between CJK
    chars, one space at CJK/latin boundaries). Blank lines are paragraph
    boundaries and preserved, and heading-like lines (short numbered lines)
    are kept standalone instead of being glued into the body.
    """
    lines = page_text.split("\n")
    if len(lines) <= 1:
        return page_text

    title = lines[0]
    body_lines = lines[1:]

    result: list[str] = [title]
    buf = ""
    for line in body_lines:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            if buf:
                result.append(buf)
                buf = ""
            result.append("")
            continue
        if _HEADING_LINE_RE.match(stripped):
            if buf:
                result.append(buf)
                buf = ""
            result.append(stripped)
            continue
        if not buf:
            buf = stripped
        else:
            buf = _join_pair(buf, stripped)
        if _SENTENCE_END_RE.search(stripped):
            result.append(buf)
            buf = ""
    if buf:
        result.append(buf)

    return "\n".join(result)

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Optional

from .config import get_settings
from .seekdb import get_connection


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)


def ensure_learning_tables() -> None:
    """幂等建表。由 main.py 的 lifespan 调用。"""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS learning_sessions (
                    session_id    VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
                    scope_id      VARCHAR(128),
                    learner_hash  CHAR(8) NOT NULL,
                    course_id     VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                    started_at    DATETIME NOT NULL,
                    last_event_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
                    ended_at      DATETIME,
                    INDEX idx_learner_course (learner_hash, course_id)
                ) ORGANIZATION HEAP
            """)
            cur.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quiz_questions (
                    id           VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
                    session_id   VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                    course_id    VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                    topic_id     VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
                    topic_name   VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
                    question_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
                    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at   DATETIME NOT NULL,
                    answered_at  DATETIME,
                    answer       TEXT,
                    correct      TINYINT,
                    box_before   INT,
                    box_after    INT,
                    INDEX idx_session (session_id)
                ) ORGANIZATION HEAP
            """)
    finally:
        conn.close()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- sessions

def create_session(session_id: str, scope_id: Optional[str], learner_hash: str,
                   course_id: str) -> None:
    now = _utc_now()
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO learning_sessions (session_id, scope_id, learner_hash, "
                "course_id, started_at, last_event_at) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)",
                (session_id, scope_id, learner_hash, course_id, now, now),
            )
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_session(session_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute("SELECT * FROM learning_sessions WHERE session_id = %s",
                        (session_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            _decode_session(row)
            return row
    finally:
        conn.close()


def touch_session(session_id: str) -> None:
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute("UPDATE learning_sessions SET last_event_at = %s "
                        "WHERE session_id = %s", (_utc_now(), session_id))
    finally:
        conn.close()


def mark_idle_sessions_ended() -> int:
    """把超过 idle 分钟没有事件的会话标记为已结束（ended_at = last_event_at）。"""
    s = get_settings()
    cutoff = _utc_now() - timedelta(minutes=s.session_idle_minutes)
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE learning_sessions SET ended_at = last_event_at "
                "WHERE ended_at IS NULL AND last_event_at < %s", (cutoff,))
            return cur.rowcount
    finally:
        conn.close()


def end_session(session_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    """结束会话：ended_at 取最后一个事件的时间。返回更新后的会话行。"""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE learning_sessions SET ended_at = last_event_at "
                "WHERE session_id = %s AND ended_at IS NULL", (session_id,))
            cur.execute("SELECT * FROM learning_sessions WHERE session_id = %s",
                        (session_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            _decode_session(row)
            return row
    finally:
        conn.close()


def session_duration_seconds(session: dict) -> float:
    """时长按最后一个事件计；不足 1 分钟按实际秒数。"""
    started = session.get("started_at")
    last = session.get("ended_at") or session.get("last_event_at")
    if isinstance(started, datetime) and isinstance(last, datetime):
        return max(0.0, (last - started).total_seconds())
    return 0.0


def _decode_session(row: Optional[dict]) -> None:
    if not row:
        return
    for key in ("started_at", "last_event_at", "ended_at"):
        if isinstance(row.get(key), datetime):
            row[key] = row[key].replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- questions

def create_question(question_id: str, session_id: str, course_id: str,
                    topic_id: str, topic_name: str, question_type: str,
                    payload: dict) -> None:
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO quiz_questions (id, session_id, course_id, topic_id, "
                "topic_name, question_type, payload, created_at) "
                "VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)",
                (question_id, session_id, course_id, topic_id, topic_name,
                 question_type, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False), _utc_now()),
            )
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_question(question_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute("SELECT * FROM quiz_questions WHERE id = %s", (question_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            if row and isinstance(row.get("payload"), str):
                row["payload"] = json.loads(row["payload"])
            for key in ("created_at", "answered_at"):
                if isinstance(row.get(key), datetime):
                    row[key] = row[key].replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()
            return row
    finally:
        conn.close()


def save_answer(question_id: str, answer: str, correct: bool,
                box_before: Optional[int], box_after: Optional[int]) -> None:
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE quiz_questions SET answered_at = %s, answer = %s, correct = %s, "
                "box_before = %s, box_after = %s WHERE id = %s",
                (_utc_now(), answer, 1 if correct else 0, box_before, box_after,
                 question_id),
            )
    finally:
        conn.close()


def last_question_of_session(session_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM quiz_questions WHERE session_id = %s "
                "ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1", (session_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            if row and isinstance(row.get("payload"), str):
                row["payload"] = json.loads(row["payload"])
            return row
    finally:
        conn.close()


def session_question_stats(session_id: str) -> dict:
    """{asked, answered, correct, wrong_by_topic: {topic_id: (name, count)}}"""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT topic_id, topic_name, correct FROM quiz_questions "
                "WHERE session_id = %s AND answered_at IS NOT NULL", (session_id,))
            rows = cur.fetchall()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    asked = len(rows)
    correct = sum(1 for r in rows if r["correct"])
    wrong_by_topic: dict[str, tuple[str, int]] = {}
    for r in rows:
        if not r["correct"]:
            tid = r["topic_id"]
            name, count = wrong_by_topic.get(tid, (r["topic_name"], 0))
            wrong_by_topic[tid] = (name, count + 1)
    return {"asked": asked, "correct": correct, "wrong_by_topic": wrong_by_topic}

102	    tokens = tokenize_term(variant)
103	    if len(tokens) >= 2:
104	        hits = sum(1 for t in tokens if t in norm_text)
105	        return hits * 2 > len(tokens)
106	    return False
107	
108	
109	def term_matches(term: Term, norm_text: str) -> bool:
110	    return any(match_variant(norm_text, v) for v in term.variants())
111	
112	
113	def body_text(content: str) -> str:
114	    """Chunk content minus markdown heading lines and blank lines.
115	
116	    Only body text counts toward support: a chunk that is just a heading
117	    plus a one-line remark is a table of contents entry, not evidence.
118	    """
119	    lines = [l.strip() for l in content.split("\n")
120	             if l.strip() and not l.lstrip().startswith("#")]
121	    return "".join(lines)
122	
123	
124	def judge_topic(found_terms: int, total_terms: int, support_chars: int,
125	                ratio_threshold: float, support_threshold: int) -> tuple[str, float]:
126	    """Judge coverage from interpretable quantities. Returns (level, score).
127	
128	    - missing: no term found at all
129	    - covered: at least `ratio_threshold` of the terms found AND at least
130	      `support_threshold` chars of supporting body text
131	    - thin: anything in between (some terms found, but not enough breadth
132	      or not enough substance)
133	
134	    score: 0 for missing; thin stays below 0.5, covered stays at or above
135	    0.5 — the radar value and blind-spot score share it, so the chart never
136	    contradicts the judgment.
137	    """
138	    if total_terms == 0 or found_terms == 0:
139	        return "missing", 0.0
140	    ratio = found_terms / total_terms
141	    support_factor = min(1.0, support_chars / support_threshold) \
142	        if support_threshold > 0 else 1.0
143	    degree = ratio * support_factor
144	    if ratio >= ratio_threshold and support_chars >= support_threshold:
145	        return "covered", 0.5 + 0.5 * degree
146	    return "thin", 0.5 * degree
147	
148	
149	def _short_ref(ref: dict) -> str:
150	    """Compact evidence reference for reasons: doc name + last heading level.
151	
152	    Full heading paths repeat the chapter title for every paragraph of the
153	    same document and made reasons unusably long.
154	    """
155	    doc = ref.get("doc") or ""
156	    heading = ref.get("heading") or ""
157	    if " > " in heading:
158	        heading = heading.rsplit(" > ", 1)[-1]
159	    if heading:
160	        return f"{doc}·{heading}" if doc else heading
161	    if ref.get("page"):
162	        return f"{doc}·第{ref['page']}页" if doc else f"第{ref['page']}页"
163	    return doc
164	
165	
166	def blind_spot_sort_key(topic_id: str, blind_spot_score) -> tuple:
167	    """Blind-spot score high→low, ties broken by topic_id (asc).
168	
169	    The single ordering used by both the fresh analysis result and the
170	    persisted run read back via get_latest(), so the two APIs and the
171	    radar page's blind-spot table always agree.
172	    """
173	    return (-float(blind_spot_score or 0), topic_id)
174	
175	
176	def build_reason(level: str, score: float, terms: list[TermEvidence],
177	                 support_chunks: int, support_chars: int) -> str:
178	    s = get_settings()
179	    ratio_t = s.coverage_term_ratio_covered
180	    support_t = s.coverage_support_chars
181	    total = len(terms)
182	    found = [t for t in terms if t.found]
183	    missing = [t for t in terms if not t.found]
184	
185	    found_parts = []
186	    for t in found:
187	        refs = [_short_ref(r) for r in t.chunk_refs[:2]]
188	        more = f" 等{len(t.chunk_refs)}段" if len(t.chunk_refs) > 2 else ""
189	        found_parts.append(f"{t.term}→{'、'.join(refs)}{more}")
190	    found_desc = "考点词 {}/{} 找到（{}）".format(
191	        len(found), total, "；".join(found_parts)) if found_parts else \
192	        f"考点词 0/{total} 找到"
193	
194	    if level == "missing":
195	        names = "、".join(t.term for t in missing)
196	        return (f"{found_desc}：{names}在笔记、课件和阅读材料中均未出现，"
197	                f"覆盖度 0。")
198	    if level == "covered":
199	        head = f"{found_desc}。"
200	        if missing:
201	            head += "未找到：" + "、".join(t.term for t in missing) + "。"
202	        ratio = len(found) / total
203	        if ratio > ratio_t:
204	            ratio_phrase = (f"考点词比例 {len(found)}/{total}，"
205	                            f"高于阈值 {ratio_t}（高出 {ratio - ratio_t:.2f}）")
206	        else:
207	            ratio_phrase = f"考点词比例 {len(found)}/{total}，达到阈值 {ratio_t}"
208	        return (head + f"支撑段落 {support_chunks} 段共 {support_chars} 字，"
209	                f"高出 covered 支撑阈值（{support_t} 字）{support_chars - support_t} 字，"
210	                f"{ratio_phrase}。")
211	    # thin
212	    ratio = len(found) / total if total else 0.0
213	    head = f"{found_desc}。"
214	    if missing:
215	        head += "未找到：" + "、".join(t.term for t in missing) + "。"
216	    if ratio < ratio_t:
217	        return (head + f"考点词比例 {ratio:.2f} 低于 covered 阈值 {ratio_t}"
218	                f"（差 {ratio_t - ratio:.2f}），判为 thin。")
219	    return (head + f"支撑段落 {support_chunks} 段共 {support_chars} 字，"
220	            f"距 covered 阈值（{support_t} 字）还差 {support_t - support_chars} 字，"
221	            f"判为 thin。")
222

225	# Analysis pipeline
226	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

228	def _load_chunks(course_id: str) -> list[ChunkInfo]:
229	    rows = get_coverage_chunks(course_id, COVERAGE_DOC_KINDS)
230	    return [
231	        ChunkInfo(
232	            chunk_id=r["id"],
233	            content=r["content"],
234	            heading=r.get("heading"),
235	            page=r.get("page"),
236	            document_name=r.get("doc_name"),
237	            body_chars=len(body_text(r["content"])),
238	            norm_text=normalize_for_match(
239	                (r.get("heading") or "") + "\n" + r["content"]),
240	        )
241	        for r in rows

244	
245	def _cosine(a, b) -> float:
246	    import numpy as np
247	    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)
248	    b = np.asarray(b, dtype=float)
249	    return float(np.dot(a, b) / (np.linalg.norm(a) * np.linalg.norm(b)))
250	
251	
252	def _parse_embedding(raw) -> Optional[list[float]]:
253	    if raw is None:
254	        return None
255	    if isinstance(raw, str):
256	        raw = json.loads(raw)
257	    return [float(x) for x in raw]
258	
259	
260	def make_chunk(chunk_id: int, content: str, heading: Optional[str] = None,
261	               document_name: Optional[str] = None,
262	               page: Optional[int] = None) -> ChunkInfo:
263	    """Build a ChunkInfo from raw text (unit tests construct these by hand)."""
264	    return ChunkInfo(
265	        chunk_id=chunk_id,
266	        content=content,
267	        heading=heading,
268	        page=page,
269	        document_name=document_name,
270	        body_chars=len(body_text(content)),
271	        norm_text=normalize_for_match((heading or "") + "\n" + content),
272	    )

274	
275	def evaluate_topic(topic: Topic, chunks: list[ChunkInfo],
276	                   min_body: int) -> tuple[list[TermEvidence], list[ChunkInfo], int]:
277	    """Match a topic's terms against material chunks (pure, no DB).
278	
279	    Returns (term_evidence, supporting_chunks, support_chars). A chunk
280	    supports the topic when at least one term matches and its body text is
281	    at least min_body chars. Semantic scores on the chunks are only used to
282	    order evidence and annotate terms.
283	    """
284	    term_evidence: list[TermEvidence] = []
285	    for term in topic.terms:
286	        refs = []
287	        matched_ids = []
288	        best_sem = None
289	        for c in chunks:
290	            if term_matches(term, c.norm_text):
291	                refs.append({"doc": c.document_name, "page": c.page,
292	                             "heading": c.heading})
293	                matched_ids.append(c.chunk_id)
294	                if c.sem_score is not None:
295	                    best_sem = max(best_sem or 0.0, c.sem_score)
296	        term_evidence.append(TermEvidence(
297	            term=term.text, aliases=list(term.aliases),
298	            found=bool(refs), chunk_refs=refs, chunk_ids=matched_ids,
299	            best_sem=best_sem,
300	        ))
301	
302	    for c in chunks:
303	        c.matched_terms = [te.term for te in term_evidence
304	                           if c.chunk_id in te.chunk_ids]
305	
306	    supporting = [c for c in chunks
307	                  if c.matched_terms and c.body_chars >= min_body]
308	    support_chars = sum(c.body_chars for c in supporting)
309	    supporting.sort(key=lambda c: (-(c.sem_score or 0), -c.body_chars))
310	    return term_evidence, supporting, support_chars
311	
312	
313	def assign_question(question_text: str, topics: list[Topic],
314	                    sims: dict[str, float]) -> tuple[Optional[str], list[str]]:
315	    """Assign one exam question to a topic (pure, no DB).
316	
317	    Primary evidence: the topics' key terms appearing in the question text;
318	    among the topics with the most matched terms, semantic similarity
319	    decides. When no topic's terms appear at all, only semantics decide.
320	    Returns (topic_id, matched_terms).
321	    """
322	    q_norm = normalize_for_match(question_text)
323	    matched: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
324	    for t in topics:
325	        hits = [term.text for term in t.terms if term_matches(term, q_norm)]
326	        if hits:
327	            matched[t.topic_id] = hits
328	
329	    if matched:
330	        best_count = max(len(v) for v in matched.values())
331	        candidates = [tid for tid, v in matched.items() if len(v) == best_count]
332	        best_topic = max(candidates, key=lambda tid: sims.get(tid, -1.0))
333	        return best_topic, matched[best_topic]
334	    if sims:
335	        return max(sims, key=lambda tid: sims[tid]), []
336	    return None, []
337	
338	
339	def _assign_exam_questions(course_id: str, topics: list[Topic],
340	                           topic_embeddings: dict[str, list[float]]
341	                           ) -> dict[str, list[ExamQuestion]]:
342	    """Assign each exam question to one topic (DB access + embeddings)."""
343	    questions = get_exam_chunks(course_id)
344	    assignment: dict[str, list[ExamQuestion]] = {t.topic_id: [] for t in topics}
345	    if not questions:
346	        return assignment
347	
348	    for q in questions:
349	        sims = {}
350	        q_vec = _parse_embedding(q.get("embedding"))
351	        if q_vec is not None:
352	            for tid, t_vec in topic_embeddings.items():
353	                sims[tid] = (1 + _cosine(q_vec, t_vec)) / 2
354	
355	        best_topic, basis = assign_question(q["content"], topics, sims)
356	        if best_topic:
357	            assignment[best_topic].append(ExamQuestion(
358	                question_no=q["question_no"],
359	                points=float(q.get("points") or 0),
360	                topic_id=best_topic,
361	                similarity=sims.get(best_topic, 0.0),
362	                matched_terms=basis,
363	                content=q["content"],
364	            ))
365	    return assignment

368	def analyze(course_id: str, syllabus_text: str, source: str = "real",
369	            session_id: Optional[str] = None) -> dict:
370	    """Run full coverage analysis. Returns the result dict and persists it."""
371	    topics = parse_syllabus(syllabus_text)
372	    if not topics:
373	        raise ValueError("没有从考试范围中解析出知识点")
374	
375	    s = get_settings()
376	    ratio_t = s.coverage_term_ratio_covered
377	    support_t = s.coverage_support_chars
378	    min_body = s.coverage_min_body_chars
379	
380	    chunks = _load_chunks(course_id)
381	    model = get_embedding_model()
382	
383	    # embeddings for chunks not recalled by hybrid search (fallback scoring)
384	    chunk_embs: dict[int, Optional[list[float]]] = {}
385	    if chunks:
386	        conn = get_connection()
387	        try:
388	            with conn.cursor() as cur:
389	                cur.execute(
390	                    "SELECT id, embedding FROM chunks WHERE id IN (%s)" %
391	                    ",".join(str(c.chunk_id) for c in chunks),
392	                )
393	                chunk_embs = {r["id"]: _parse_embedding(r["embedding"])
394	                              for r in cur.fetchall()}
395	        finally:
396	            conn.close()
397	
398	    topic_results: list[TopicResult] = []
399	    topic_embeddings = {
400	        t.topic_id: model.embed_one(t.search_query, is_query=True)
401	        for t in topics
402	    }
403	
404	    for topic in topics:
405	        query_vec = topic_embeddings[topic.topic_id]
406	        hits, _, _ = hybrid_search(
407	            query_text=topic.search_query,
408	            query_vector=query_vec,
409	            course_id=course_id,
410	            doc_kinds=COVERAGE_DOC_KINDS,
411	            top_k=10,
412	        )
413	        hybrid_scores = {h["id"]: h for h in hits}
414	
415	        for c in chunks:
416	            h = hybrid_scores.get(c.chunk_id)
417	            if h is not None:
418	                c.sem_score = h.get("_semantic_score")
419	                c.kw_score = h.get("_keyword_score")
420	            elif chunk_embs.get(c.chunk_id) is not None:
421	                c.sem_score = (1 + _cosine(query_vec, chunk_embs[c.chunk_id])) / 2
422	                c.kw_score = None
423	            else:
424	                c.sem_score = None
425	                c.kw_score = None
426	
427	        # term matching over ALL material chunks (not just the hybrid recall
428	        # pool): the judgment must not depend on recall completeness
429	        term_evidence, supporting, support_chars = evaluate_topic(
430	            topic, chunks, min_body)
431	
432	        found_count = sum(1 for te in term_evidence if te.found)
433	        level, score = judge_topic(found_count, len(topic.terms),
434	                                   support_chars, ratio_t, support_t)
435	        reason = build_reason(level, score, term_evidence,
436	                              len(supporting), support_chars)
437	
438	        best = supporting[0] if supporting else None
439	
440	        topic_results.append(TopicResult(
441	            topic_id=topic.topic_id,
442	            topic_name=topic.name,
443	            keywords=topic.keywords,
444	            terms=term_evidence,
445	            coverage_level=level,
446	            coverage_score=round(score, 4),
447	            support_chunks=len(supporting),
448	            support_chars=support_chars,
449	            best_evidence=best,
450	            exam_weight=0.0,
451	            exam_questions=[],
452	            blind_spot_score=0.0,
453	            reason=reason,
454	            all_evidence=supporting,
455	        ))
456	
457	    exam_assignment = _assign_exam_questions(course_id, topics, topic_embeddings)
458	    for tr in topic_results:
459	        qs = exam_assignment.get(tr.topic_id, [])
460	        tr.exam_questions = qs
461	        tr.exam_weight = sum(q.points for q in qs)
462	        tr.blind_spot_score = round(tr.exam_weight * (1.0 - tr.coverage_score), 2)
463	
464	    topic_results.sort(
465	        key=lambda t: blind_spot_sort_key(t.topic_id, t.blind_spot_score))
466	
467	    config_json = json.dumps({
468	        "term_ratio_covered": ratio_t,
469	        "support_chars_covered": support_t,
470	        "min_body_chars": min_body,
471	    })
472	    topics_json = json.dumps(
473	        [{"id": t.topic_id, "name": t.name, "keywords": t.keywords,
474	          "terms": [{"text": term.text, "aliases": term.aliases}
475	                    for term in t.terms]} for t in topics],
476	        ensure_ascii=False,
477	    )
478	
479	    items = [_item_dict(tr) for tr in topic_results]
480	    run_id = save_coverage_run(course_id, source, topics_json, config_json, items)
481	
482	    insert_usage_event(course_id, source, "analyze", {
483	        "run_id": run_id,
484	        "topic_count": len(topics),
485	        "syllabus_text": syllabus_text[:500],
486	    }, session_id=session_id)
487	
488	    return _format_result(run_id, course_id, topic_results, topics_json,
489	                          config_json)
490

"""Coverage analysis: per-topic key-term evidence, exam weight, blind spots.

Judgment is based on whether a topic's key terms (考点词) actually appear in
the course materials (notes / slides / paper). Semantic scores from
DBMS_HYBRID_SEARCH rank and annotate the evidence but never decide coverage:
with bge-small-zh-v1.5, cosine similarity for unrelated short Chinese terms
stays above ~0.7, so it cannot separate "covered" from "missing" (measured
in DEVLOG sessions 04/05).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional

from .config import get_settings
from .seekdb import (
    hybrid_search, get_connection, save_coverage_run,
    get_latest_coverage, insert_usage_event, get_coverage_chunks,
    get_exam_chunks,
)
from .embedding import get_embedding_model
from .syllabus import Topic, Term, normalize_for_match, tokenize_term, parse_syllabus

COVERAGE_DOC_KINDS = ["notes", "slides", "paper"]


@dataclass
class ChunkInfo:
    """One candidate chunk from the course materials."""
    chunk_id: int
    content: str
    heading: Optional[str]
    page: Optional[int]
    document_name: Optional[str]
    body_chars: int = 0
    norm_text: str = ""
    matched_terms: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    sem_score: Optional[float] = None
    kw_score: Optional[float] = None


@dataclass
class TermEvidence:
    term: str
    aliases: list[str]
    found: bool
    # chunks where the term (or an alias) appears, as {doc, page, heading}
    chunk_refs: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    # ids of the chunks above, to derive per-chunk matched terms
    chunk_ids: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    best_sem: Optional[float] = None


@dataclass
class ExamQuestion:
    question_no: int
    points: float
    topic_id: str
    similarity: float
    matched_terms: list[str]
    content: str


@dataclass
class TopicResult:
    topic_id: str
    topic_name: str
    keywords: list[str]
    terms: list[TermEvidence]
    coverage_level: str
    coverage_score: float
    support_chunks: int
    support_chars: int
    best_evidence: Optional[ChunkInfo]
    exam_weight: float
    exam_questions: list[ExamQuestion]
    blind_spot_score: float
    reason: str
    all_evidence: list[ChunkInfo] = field(default_factory=list)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pure matching logic (unit-tested without a database)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def match_variant(norm_text: str, variant: str) -> bool:
    """Does one term variant (text or alias) appear in normalized text?

    A variant with a single token must appear contiguously. A multi-token
    variant ("SQL 查询", "事务的 ACID 特性") matches when a strict majority of
    its content tokens occur in the same paragraph — generic trailing words
    (的/特性) must not block an otherwise exact co-occurrence.
    """
    norm_text = normalize_for_match(norm_text)
    v = normalize_for_match(variant)
    if not v or not norm_text:
        return False
    if v in norm_text:
        return True
    tokens = tokenize_term(variant)
    if len(tokens) >= 2:
        hits = sum(1 for t in tokens if t in norm_text)
        return hits * 2 > len(tokens)
    return False


def term_matches(term: Term, norm_text: str) -> bool:
    return any(match_variant(norm_text, v) for v in term.variants())


def body_text(content: str) -> str:
    """Chunk content minus markdown heading lines and blank lines.

    Only body text counts toward support: a chunk that is just a heading
    plus a one-line remark is a table of contents entry, not evidence.
    """
    lines = [l.strip() for l in content.split("\n")
             if l.strip() and not l.lstrip().startswith("#")]
    return "".join(lines)


def judge_topic(found_terms: int, total_terms: int, support_chars: int,
                ratio_threshold: float, support_threshold: int) -> tuple[str, float]:
    """Judge coverage from interpretable quantities. Returns (level, score).

    - missing: no term found at all
    - covered: at least `ratio_threshold` of the terms found AND at least
      `support_threshold` chars of supporting body text
    - thin: anything in between (some terms found, but not enough breadth
      or not enough substance)

    score: 0 for missing; thin stays below 0.5, covered stays at or above
    0.5 — the radar value and blind-spot score share it, so the chart never
    contradicts the judgment.
    """
    if total_terms == 0 or found_terms == 0:
        return "missing", 0.0
    ratio = found_terms / total_terms
    support_factor = min(1.0, support_chars / support_threshold) \
        if support_threshold > 0 else 1.0
    degree = ratio * support_factor
    if ratio >= ratio_threshold and support_chars >= support_threshold:
        return "covered", 0.5 + 0.5 * degree
    return "thin", 0.5 * degree


def _short_ref(ref: dict) -> str:
    """Compact evidence reference for reasons: doc name + last heading level.

    Full heading paths repeat the chapter title for every paragraph of the
    same document and made reasons unusably long.
    """
    doc = ref.get("doc") or ""
    heading = ref.get("heading") or ""
    if " > " in heading:
        heading = heading.rsplit(" > ", 1)[-1]
    if heading:
        return f"{doc}·{heading}" if doc else heading
    if ref.get("page"):
        return f"{doc}·第{ref['page']}页" if doc else f"第{ref['page']}页"
    return doc


def blind_spot_sort_key(topic_id: str, blind_spot_score) -> tuple:
    """Blind-spot score high→low, ties broken by topic_id (asc).

    The single ordering used by both the fresh analysis result and the
    persisted run read back via get_latest(), so the two APIs and the
    radar page's blind-spot table always agree.
    """
    return (-float(blind_spot_score or 0), topic_id)


def build_reason(level: str, score: float, terms: list[TermEvidence],
                 support_chunks: int, support_chars: int) -> str:
    s = get_settings()
    ratio_t = s.coverage_term_ratio_covered
    support_t = s.coverage_support_chars
    total = len(terms)
    found = [t for t in terms if t.found]
    missing = [t for t in terms if not t.found]

    found_parts = []
    for t in found:
        refs = [_short_ref(r) for r in t.chunk_refs[:2]]
        more = f" 等{len(t.chunk_refs)}段" if len(t.chunk_refs) > 2 else ""
        found_parts.append(f"{t.term}→{'、'.join(refs)}{more}")
    found_desc = "考点词 {}/{} 找到（{}）".format(
        len(found), total, "；".join(found_parts)) if found_parts else \
        f"考点词 0/{total} 找到"

    if level == "missing":
        names = "、".join(t.term for t in missing)
        return (f"{found_desc}：{names}在笔记、课件和阅读材料中均未出现，"
                f"覆盖度 0。")
    if level == "covered":
        head = f"{found_desc}。"
        if missing:
            head += "未找到：" + "、".join(t.term for t in missing) + "。"
        ratio = len(found) / total
        if ratio > ratio_t:
            ratio_phrase = (f"考点词比例 {len(found)}/{total}，"
                            f"高于阈值 {ratio_t}（高出 {ratio - ratio_t:.2f}）")
        else:
            ratio_phrase = f"考点词比例 {len(found)}/{total}，达到阈值 {ratio_t}"
        return (head + f"支撑段落 {support_chunks} 段共 {support_chars} 字，"
                f"高出 covered 支撑阈值（{support_t} 字）{support_chars - support_t} 字，"
                f"{ratio_phrase}。")
    # thin
    ratio = len(found) / total if total else 0.0
    head = f"{found_desc}。"
    if missing:
        head += "未找到：" + "、".join(t.term for t in missing) + "。"
    if ratio < ratio_t:
        return (head + f"考点词比例 {ratio:.2f} 低于 covered 阈值 {ratio_t}"
                f"（差 {ratio_t - ratio:.2f}），判为 thin。")
    return (head + f"支撑段落 {support_chunks} 段共 {support_chars} 字，"
            f"距 covered 阈值（{support_t} 字）还差 {support_t - support_chars} 字，"
            f"判为 thin。")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Analysis pipeline
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _load_chunks(course_id: str) -> list[ChunkInfo]:
    rows = get_coverage_chunks(course_id, COVERAGE_DOC_KINDS)
    return [
        ChunkInfo(
            chunk_id=r["id"],
            content=r["content"],
            heading=r.get("heading"),
            page=r.get("page"),
            document_name=r.get("doc_name"),
            body_chars=len(body_text(r["content"])),
            norm_text=normalize_for_match(
                (r.get("heading") or "") + "\n" + r["content"]),
        )
        for r in rows
    ]


def _cosine(a, b) -> float:
    import numpy as np
    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)
    b = np.asarray(b, dtype=float)
    return float(np.dot(a, b) / (np.linalg.norm(a) * np.linalg.norm(b)))


def _parse_embedding(raw) -> Optional[list[float]]:
    if raw is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(raw, str):
        raw = json.loads(raw)
    return [float(x) for x in raw]


def make_chunk(chunk_id: int, content: str, heading: Optional[str] = None,
               document_name: Optional[str] = None,
               page: Optional[int] = None) -> ChunkInfo:
    """Build a ChunkInfo from raw text (unit tests construct these by hand)."""
    return ChunkInfo(
        chunk_id=chunk_id,
        content=content,
        heading=heading,
        page=page,
        document_name=document_name,
        body_chars=len(body_text(content)),
        norm_text=normalize_for_match((heading or "") + "\n" + content),
    )


def evaluate_topic(topic: Topic, chunks: list[ChunkInfo],
                   min_body: int) -> tuple[list[TermEvidence], list[ChunkInfo], int]:
    """Match a topic's terms against material chunks (pure, no DB).

    Returns (term_evidence, supporting_chunks, support_chars). A chunk
    supports the topic when at least one term matches and its body text is
    at least min_body chars. Semantic scores on the chunks are only used to
    order evidence and annotate terms.
    """
    term_evidence: list[TermEvidence] = []
    for term in topic.terms:
        refs = []
        matched_ids = []
        best_sem = None
        for c in chunks:
            if term_matches(term, c.norm_text):
                refs.append({"doc": c.document_name, "page": c.page,
                             "heading": c.heading})
                matched_ids.append(c.chunk_id)
                if c.sem_score is not None:
                    best_sem = max(best_sem or 0.0, c.sem_score)
        term_evidence.append(TermEvidence(
            term=term.text, aliases=list(term.aliases),
            found=bool(refs), chunk_refs=refs, chunk_ids=matched_ids,
            best_sem=best_sem,
        ))

    for c in chunks:
        c.matched_terms = [te.term for te in term_evidence
                           if c.chunk_id in te.chunk_ids]

    supporting = [c for c in chunks
                  if c.matched_terms and c.body_chars >= min_body]
    support_chars = sum(c.body_chars for c in supporting)
    supporting.sort(key=lambda c: (-(c.sem_score or 0), -c.body_chars))
    return term_evidence, supporting, support_chars


def assign_question(question_text: str, topics: list[Topic],
                    sims: dict[str, float]) -> tuple[Optional[str], list[str]]:
    """Assign one exam question to a topic (pure, no DB).

    Primary evidence: the topics' key terms appearing in the question text;
    among the topics with the most matched terms, semantic similarity
    decides. When no topic's terms appear at all, only semantics decide.
    Returns (topic_id, matched_terms).
    """
    q_norm = normalize_for_match(question_text)
    matched: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for t in topics:
        hits = [term.text for term in t.terms if term_matches(term, q_norm)]
        if hits:
            matched[t.topic_id] = hits

    if matched:
        best_count = max(len(v) for v in matched.values())
        candidates = [tid for tid, v in matched.items() if len(v) == best_count]
        best_topic = max(candidates, key=lambda tid: sims.get(tid, -1.0))
        return best_topic, matched[best_topic]
    if sims:
        return max(sims, key=lambda tid: sims[tid]), []
    return None, []


def _assign_exam_questions(course_id: str, topics: list[Topic],
                           topic_embeddings: dict[str, list[float]]
                           ) -> dict[str, list[ExamQuestion]]:
    """Assign each exam question to one topic (DB access + embeddings)."""
    questions = get_exam_chunks(course_id)
    assignment: dict[str, list[ExamQuestion]] = {t.topic_id: [] for t in topics}
    if not questions:
        return assignment

    for q in questions:
        sims = {}
        q_vec = _parse_embedding(q.get("embedding"))
        if q_vec is not None:
            for tid, t_vec in topic_embeddings.items():
                sims[tid] = (1 + _cosine(q_vec, t_vec)) / 2

        best_topic, basis = assign_question(q["content"], topics, sims)
        if best_topic:
            assignment[best_topic].append(ExamQuestion(
                question_no=q["question_no"],
                points=float(q.get("points") or 0),
                topic_id=best_topic,
                similarity=sims.get(best_topic, 0.0),
                matched_terms=basis,
                content=q["content"],
            ))
    return assignment


def analyze(course_id: str, syllabus_text: str, source: str = "real",
            session_id: Optional[str] = None) -> dict:
    """Run full coverage analysis. Returns the result dict and persists it."""
    topics = parse_syllabus(syllabus_text)
    if not topics:
        raise ValueError("没有从考试范围中解析出知识点")

    s = get_settings()
    ratio_t = s.coverage_term_ratio_covered
    support_t = s.coverage_support_chars
    min_body = s.coverage_min_body_chars

    chunks = _load_chunks(course_id)
    model = get_embedding_model()

    # embeddings for chunks not recalled by hybrid search (fallback scoring)
    chunk_embs: dict[int, Optional[list[float]]] = {}
    if chunks:
        conn = get_connection()
        try:
            with conn.cursor() as cur:
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT id, embedding FROM chunks WHERE id IN (%s)" %
                    ",".join(str(c.chunk_id) for c in chunks),
                )
                chunk_embs = {r["id"]: _parse_embedding(r["embedding"])
                              for r in cur.fetchall()}
        finally:
            conn.close()

    topic_results: list[TopicResult] = []
    topic_embeddings = {
        t.topic_id: model.embed_one(t.search_query, is_query=True)
        for t in topics
    }

    for topic in topics:
        query_vec = topic_embeddings[topic.topic_id]
        hits, _, _ = hybrid_search(
            query_text=topic.search_query,
            query_vector=query_vec,
            course_id=course_id,
            doc_kinds=COVERAGE_DOC_KINDS,
            top_k=10,
        )
        hybrid_scores = {h["id"]: h for h in hits}

        for c in chunks:
            h = hybrid_scores.get(c.chunk_id)
            if h is not None:
                c.sem_score = h.get("_semantic_score")
                c.kw_score = h.get("_keyword_score")
            elif chunk_embs.get(c.chunk_id) is not None:
                c.sem_score = (1 + _cosine(query_vec, chunk_embs[c.chunk_id])) / 2
                c.kw_score = None
            else:
                c.sem_score = None
                c.kw_score = None

        # term matching over ALL material chunks (not just the hybrid recall
        # pool): the judgment must not depend on recall completeness
        term_evidence, supporting, support_chars = evaluate_topic(
            topic, chunks, min_body)

        found_count = sum(1 for te in term_evidence if te.found)
        level, score = judge_topic(found_count, len(topic.terms),
                                   support_chars, ratio_t, support_t)
        reason = build_reason(level, score, term_evidence,
                              len(supporting), support_chars)

        best = supporting[0] if supporting else None

        topic_results.append(TopicResult(
            topic_id=topic.topic_id,
            topic_name=topic.name,
            keywords=topic.keywords,
            terms=term_evidence,
            coverage_level=level,
            coverage_score=round(score, 4),
            support_chunks=len(supporting),
            support_chars=support_chars,
            best_evidence=best,
            exam_weight=0.0,
            exam_questions=[],
            blind_spot_score=0.0,
            reason=reason,
            all_evidence=supporting,
        ))

    exam_assignment = _assign_exam_questions(course_id, topics, topic_embeddings)
    for tr in topic_results:
        qs = exam_assignment.get(tr.topic_id, [])
        tr.exam_questions = qs
        tr.exam_weight = sum(q.points for q in qs)
        tr.blind_spot_score = round(tr.exam_weight * (1.0 - tr.coverage_score), 2)

    topic_results.sort(
        key=lambda t: blind_spot_sort_key(t.topic_id, t.blind_spot_score))

    config_json = json.dumps({
        "term_ratio_covered": ratio_t,
        "support_chars_covered": support_t,
        "min_body_chars": min_body,
    })
    topics_json = json.dumps(
        [{"id": t.topic_id, "name": t.name, "keywords": t.keywords,
          "terms": [{"text": term.text, "aliases": term.aliases}
                    for term in t.terms]} for t in topics],
        ensure_ascii=False,
    )

    items = [_item_dict(tr) for tr in topic_results]
    run_id = save_coverage_run(course_id, source, topics_json, config_json, items)

    insert_usage_event(course_id, source, "analyze", {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "topic_count": len(topics),
        "syllabus_text": syllabus_text[:500],
    }, session_id=session_id)

    return _format_result(run_id, course_id, topic_results, topics_json,
                          config_json)


def _item_dict(tr: TopicResult) -> dict:
    best = tr.best_evidence
    return {
        "topic_id": tr.topic_id,
        "topic_name": tr.topic_name,
        "keywords_json": json.dumps(tr.keywords, ensure_ascii=False),
        "coverage_level": tr.coverage_level,
        "coverage_score": tr.coverage_score,
        "terms_json": json.dumps([{
            "term": te.term,
            "aliases": te.aliases,
            "found": te.found,
            "chunks": te.chunk_refs[:10],
            "best_sem": te.best_sem,
        } for te in tr.terms], ensure_ascii=False),
        "support_chunks": tr.support_chunks,
        "support_chars": tr.support_chars,
        "best_sem_score": best.sem_score if best else None,
        "best_kw_score": best.kw_score if best else None,
        "best_content": best.content if best else None,
        "best_heading": best.heading if best else None,
        "best_page": best.page if best else None,
        "best_doc_name": best.document_name if best else None,
        "exam_weight": tr.exam_weight,
        "exam_qs_json": json.dumps([{
            "question_no": q.question_no, "points": q.points,
            "similarity": q.similarity, "matched_terms": q.matched_terms,
            "content": q.content,
        } for q in tr.exam_questions], ensure_ascii=False),
        "blind_spot_score": tr.blind_spot_score,
        "reason": tr.reason,
    }


def _format_result(run_id: int, course_id: str,
                   topic_results: list[TopicResult],
                   topics_json: str, config_json: str) -> dict:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
    return {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "course_id": course_id,
        "created_at": now.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "topics": json.loads(topics_json),
        "config": json.loads(config_json),
        "items": [_format_topic_result(tr) for tr in topic_results],
    }


def _format_topic_result(tr: TopicResult) -> dict:
    best = tr.best_evidence
    return {
        "topic_id": tr.topic_id,
        "topic_name": tr.topic_name,
        "keywords": tr.keywords,
        "coverage_level": tr.coverage_level,
        "coverage_score": tr.coverage_score,
        "support_chunks": tr.support_chunks,
        "support_chars": tr.support_chars,
        "terms": [{
            "term": te.term,
            "aliases": te.aliases,
            "found": te.found,
            "chunks": te.chunk_refs,
            "best_sem": te.best_sem,
        } for te in tr.terms],
        "best_evidence": {
            "content": best.content,
            "heading": best.heading,
            "page": best.page,
            "document_name": best.document_name,
            "semantic_score": best.sem_score,
            "keyword_score": best.kw_score,
            "matched_terms": best.matched_terms,
            "body_chars": best.body_chars,
        } if best else None,
        "exam_weight": tr.exam_weight,
        "exam_questions": [
            {"question_no": q.question_no, "points": q.points,
             "similarity": q.similarity, "matched_terms": q.matched_terms,
             "content": q.content}
            for q in tr.exam_questions
        ],
        "blind_spot_score": tr.blind_spot_score,
        "reason": tr.reason,
        "all_evidence": [
            {
                "content": e.content,
                "heading": e.heading,
                "page": e.page,
                "document_name": e.document_name,
                "semantic_score": e.sem_score,
                "keyword_score": e.kw_score,
                "matched_terms": e.matched_terms,
                "body_chars": e.body_chars,
            }
            for e in tr.all_evidence
        ],
    }


def get_latest(course_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    """Get the latest coverage analysis for a course from the database."""
    run = get_latest_coverage(course_id)
    if not run:
        return None
    items = []
    for item in run.get("items", []):
        exam_qs = json.loads(item.get("exam_qs_json") or "[]")
        keywords = json.loads(item.get("keywords_json") or "[]")
        terms = json.loads(item.get("terms_json") or "[]")
        items.append({
            "topic_id": item["topic_id"],
            "topic_name": item["topic_name"],
            "keywords": keywords,
            "coverage_level": item.get("coverage_level"),
            "coverage_score": item.get("coverage_score"),
            "support_chunks": item.get("support_chunks"),
            "support_chars": item.get("support_chars"),
            "terms": terms,
            "best_evidence": {
                "content": item.get("best_content"),
                "heading": item.get("best_heading"),
                "page": item.get("best_page"),
                "document_name": item.get("best_doc_name"),
                "semantic_score": item.get("best_sem_score"),
                "keyword_score": item.get("best_kw_score"),
            } if item.get("best_content") else None,
            "exam_weight": item.get("exam_weight", 0),
            "exam_questions": exam_qs,
            "blind_spot_score": item.get("blind_spot_score"),
            "reason": item.get("reason"),
        })
    # the persisted run comes back ORDER BY topic_id; re-apply the same
    # ordering as analyze() so both APIs return an identical sequence
    items.sort(key=lambda it: blind_spot_sort_key(
        it["topic_id"], it.get("blind_spot_score")))
    return {
        "run_id": run["id"],
        "course_id": run["course_id"],
        "created_at": run["created_at"],
        "topics": json.loads(run.get("topics_json") or "[]"),
        "config": json.loads(run.get("config_json") or "{}"),
        "items": items,
    }

"""学习会话路由：start（bootstrap）/ end（会话小结 + 复习计划）。"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import uuid
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, Header, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel

from ..config import get_settings
from ..mastery import learner_hash, format_session_summary
from ..pc_client import (
    PowerContextClient, PowerContextUnavailable, bootstrap_opening_line,
)
from ..seekdb import insert_usage_event
from .. import learning_store
from ..coach import (
    MEMORY_NOTICE, build_review_plan_inputs, coverage_snapshot, due_topics,
    load_mastery_states, review_plan_opening, update_review_plan,
)

router = APIRouter()


class SessionStartRequest(BaseModel):
    learner: str
    course_id: str


@router.get("/api/coach/status")
def coach_status():
    from ..llm import get_llm_client
    s = get_settings()
    llm = get_llm_client()
    pc = PowerContextClient()
    pc_ok, pc_detail = pc.health()
    return {
        "llm": {
            "configured": llm.configured,
            "model": llm.model,
            "base_url": llm.base_url,
        },
        "powercontext": {"ok": pc_ok, "detail": pc_detail},
        "session_idle_minutes": s.session_idle_minutes,
    }


@router.post("/api/sessions/start")
def session_start(req: SessionStartRequest,
                  x_examradar_source: Optional[str] = Header(None)):
    source = "auto" if x_examradar_source == "auto" else "real"
    learner = (req.learner or "").strip()
    if not learner:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "learner 不能为空"}, status_code=400)

    session_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:16]
    learning_store.mark_idle_sessions_ended()

    s = get_settings()
    client = PowerContextClient()
    scope_id: Optional[str] = None
    memory_ok = True
    bootstrap: Optional[dict] = None
    opening_line: Optional[str] = None
    mastery: dict[str, dict] = {}

    try:
        scope_id = client.ensure_scope(learner, req.course_id)
    except PowerContextUnavailable:
        memory_ok = False

    if scope_id and memory_ok:
        try:
            bootstrap = client.bootstrap(scope_id, event_id=session_id,
                                         max_bytes=s.pc_context_max_bytes)
            mastery = load_mastery_states(client, scope_id)
            opening_line = (review_plan_opening(client, scope_id)
                            or bootstrap_opening_line(bootstrap))
        except PowerContextUnavailable:
            memory_ok = False
            bootstrap = None
            opening_line = None

    cov = coverage_snapshot(req.course_id)
    due = due_topics(mastery)
    blind = sorted(
        (it for it in (cov or {}).get("items") or []
         if it["coverage_level"] in ("thin", "missing")),
        key=lambda it: -it["blind_spot_score"])

    learning_store.create_session(session_id, scope_id, learner_hash(learner),
                                  req.course_id)

@router.post("/api/sessions/end")
async def session_end(request: Request):
    """同时接受普通 JSON 和 sendBeacon 的 text/plain。"""
    raw = await request.body()
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw or b"{}")
    except Exception:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "请求体不是合法 JSON"}, status_code=400)
    session_id = (data.get("session_id") or "").strip()
    if not session_id:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "session_id 不能为空"}, status_code=400)
    source = request.headers.get("X-ExamRadar-Source")
    if source != "auto" and data.get("source") == "auto":
        source = "auto"
    source = "auto" if source == "auto" else "real"

    session = learning_store.get_session(session_id)
    if not session:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "会话不存在"}, status_code=404)
    already_ended = session.get("ended_at") is not None

    if not already_ended:
        # 结束请求本身是一个事件：时长按最后一个事件计
        learning_store.touch_session(session_id)
        session = learning_store.end_session(session_id)

    stats = learning_store.session_question_stats(session_id)
    duration = learning_store.session_duration_seconds(session or {})

    # scope_id 为空说明会话创建时 PowerContext 就不可用，直接进入降级
    memory_ok = bool(session and session.get("scope_id"))
    summary_memory: Optional[dict] = None
    plan_memory: Optional[dict] = None
    if not already_ended and session and session.get("scope_id"):
        client = PowerContextClient()
        scope_id = session["scope_id"]
        try:
            weak = sorted(
                ((tid, name, count) for tid, (name, count)
                 in stats["wrong_by_topic"].items()),
                key=lambda x: -x[2])
            text = format_session_summary(
                max(duration, 0.0) / 60.0, stats["asked"], stats["correct"], weak,
                started_at=session.get("started_at"))
            created = client.remember(scope_id, "session", text)
            if created:
                try:
                    client.put_tags(scope_id, created[0],
                                    ["examradar", "type-session"])
                except Exception:
                    pass
                summary_memory = {"artifact_id": created[0],
                                  "revision": created[1], "text": text}
            cov = coverage_snapshot(session["course_id"])
            mastery = load_mastery_states(client, scope_id)
            plan_memory = update_review_plan(client, scope_id,
                                             *build_review_plan_inputs(mastery, cov))
        except PowerContextUnavailable:
            memory_ok = False

    if not already_ended:
        insert_usage_event(session["course_id"], source, "session_end", {
            "session_id": session_id,
            "duration_seconds": round(duration, 1),
            "questions_asked": stats["asked"],
            "questions_correct": stats["correct"],
        }, session_id=session_id)

    return {
        "session_id": session_id,
        "already_ended": already_ended,
        "duration_seconds": round(duration, 1),
        "questions_asked": stats["asked"],
        "questions_correct": stats["correct"],
        "memory_ok": memory_ok,
        "memory_notice": None if memory_ok else MEMORY_NOTICE,
        "summary_memory": summary_memory,
        "review_plan": plan_memory,
    }

def step_coach(ctx: Ctx) -> StepResult:
    res = StepResult("复习教练")
    ts = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
    learner = f"e2e教练{ts}"

    status = ctx.app.get("/api/coach/status")
    pc_ok = bool((status.get("powercontext") or {}).get("ok"))
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "/api/coach/status：PowerContext 可用", pc_ok,
        f"llm configured={bool((status.get('llm') or {}).get('configured'))}"
        f"（CI 栈不配大模型，走无模型路径）",
    ))

    # ---- 会话 1：新学习者，bootstrap 必须为空 ----
    s1 = ctx.app.post_json("/api/sessions/start",
                           {"learner": learner, "course_id": COURSE_ID})
    scope_id = s1.get("scope_id") or ""
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "新学习者开始会话：scope 已建、bootstrap 为空",
        bool(scope_id)
        and (s1.get("bootstrap") is None or not (s1.get("bootstrap") or {}).get("items"))
        and s1.get("opening_line") is None,
        f"scope_id={scope_id[:12]}…，bootstrap items="
        f"{(s1.get('bootstrap') or {}).get('items') or []}",
    ))
    sid1 = s1.get("session_id") or ""

    # ---- 第 1 题：自动选题应为盲区第一 t04（missing → 往年原题自测）----
    q1 = ctx.app.post_json("/api/quiz/next", {"session_id": sid1})
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "第 1 题自动选题 = 盲区第一 t04，missing 走往年原题自测",
        q1.get("topic_id") == BLIND_SPOT_TOP_TOPIC
        and q1.get("question_type") == "self"
        and "笔记里没有" in (q1.get("hint") or "")
        and "期末试卷" in ((q1.get("source") or {}).get("label") or "")
        and q1.get("self_ratings") == SELF_RATINGS,
        f"topic={q1.get('topic_id')}，题型={q1.get('question_type')}，"
        f"出处={((q1.get('source') or {}).get('label') or '')[:60]}",
    ))
    q1_text = (q1.get("question") or "").strip()

    # ---- 自测答错（不会）：box 1→1，写错题记忆 ----
    a1 = ctx.app.post_json("/api/quiz/answer",
                           {"question_id": q1["question_id"],
                            "self_rating": "不会"})
    m1 = a1.get("mastery") or {}
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "自测答错（不会）：correct=False，盒 1→1，错题记忆已写",
        a1.get("correct") is False and a1.get("box_before") == 1
        and a1.get("box_after") == 1
        and bool((a1.get("mistake_memory") or {}).get("artifact_id")),
        f"卡片 artifact={m1.get('artifact_id')} rev={m1.get('revision')}，"
        f"错题 artifact={(a1.get('mistake_memory') or {}).get('artifact_id')}",
    ))

    # ---- 第 2 题：同知识点再答对（会）：prepare 应召回刚才的错题 ----
    q2 = ctx.app.post_json("/api/quiz/next",
                           {"session_id": sid1, "topic_id": BLIND_SPOT_TOP_TOPIC})
    a2 = ctx.app.post_json("/api/quiz/answer",
                           {"question_id": q2["question_id"], "self_rating": "会"})
    m2 = a2.get("mastery") or {}
    mistake_hist = q2.get("mistake_history") or []
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "context/prepare 召回上次答错的错题（「你之前在这里错过」材料）",
        bool(mistake_hist) and any("【错题】" in (h.get("text") or "")
                                   for h in mistake_hist),
        f"召回 {len(mistake_hist)} 条，第一条："
        f"{((mistake_hist[0].get('text') or '')[:50]) if mistake_hist else '—'}",
    ))
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "同知识点答对（会）：盒 1→2，卡片 revision 递增",
        a2.get("correct") is True and a2.get("box_before") == 1
        and a2.get("box_after") == 2
        and bool(m2.get("artifact_id"))
        and int(m2.get("revision") or 0) > int(m1.get("revision") or 0),
        f"卡片 artifact={m2.get('artifact_id')}，rev "
        f"{m1.get('revision')}→{m2.get('revision')}",
    ))

    # ---- 第 3 题：thin 知识点（t08）考点词填空，故意答错 ----
    q3 = ctx.app.post_json("/api/quiz/next",
                           {"session_id": sid1, "question_type": "fill"})
    src3 = (q3.get("source") or {}).get("label") or ""
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "第 3 题自动选题 = t08（thin），填空题出考点词所在段落",
        q3.get("topic_id") == "t08" and q3.get("question_type") == "fill"
        and "＿＿＿" in (q3.get("question") or "")
        and "05-事务" in src3,
        f"topic={q3.get('topic_id')}，出处={src3[:60]}",
    ))
    a3 = ctx.app.post_json("/api/quiz/answer",
                           {"question_id": q3["question_id"],
                            "answer": "完全不会"})
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "填空题挖空的是考点词本身（判分回执里的正确答案）",
        a3.get("correct") is False
        and a3.get("expected_answer") in ("隔离级别", "MVCC"),
        f"expected_answer={a3.get('expected_answer')}（来自 t08 的考点词）",
    ))

    # ---- 结束会话 ----
    e1 = ctx.app.post_json("/api/sessions/end", {"session_id": sid1})
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "结束会话：3 题 1 对，时长按最后事件计，会话小结入记忆",
        e1.get("questions_asked") == 3 and e1.get("questions_correct") == 1
        and (e1.get("duration_seconds") or 0) >= 0
        and bool((e1.get("summary_memory") or {}).get("artifact_id")),
        f"duration={e1.get('duration_seconds')}s，"
        f"小结 artifact={(e1.get('summary_memory') or {}).get('artifact_id')}",
    ))

    # ---- 会话 2：开场白提到上次答错的知识点 ----
    s2 = ctx.app.post_json("/api/sessions/start",
                           {"learner": learner, "course_id": COURSE_ID})
    opening = s2.get("opening_line") or ""
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "新会话开场白提到上次答错的知识点（复习计划首行）",
        "错" in opening and ("函数依赖与范式" in opening
                             or "隔离级别与 MVCC" in opening),
        opening[:80] or "（空）",
    ))
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "会话 2 bootstrap 就绪（复习计划带 bootstrap-context 标签）",
        (s2.get("bootstrap") or {}).get("status") == "ready"
        and bool((s2.get("bootstrap") or {}).get("items")),
        f"bootstrap items={len(((s2.get('bootstrap') or {}).get('items') or []))}",
    ))

    # ---- PowerContext 直接核对：计划 handle / 标签 / 卡片 revision 历史 ----
    handle = ctx.pc.get(
        f"/v1/scopes/{scope_id}/artifact-handles/atomic-memory/review-plan")
    plan_artifact = ((handle.get("artifact") or handle) or {}).get("artifact_id")
    plan_info = e1.get("review_plan") or {}
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "复习计划 handle 指向会话结束时更新的 artifact",
        bool(plan_artifact) and plan_artifact == plan_info.get("artifact_id"),
        f"handle→{plan_artifact}，结束会话写入 rev={plan_info.get('revision')}",
    ))
    tags = ctx.pc.get(
        f"/v1/scopes/{scope_id}/artifacts/atomic-memory/{plan_artifact}/tags"
    ).get("tags") or []
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "复习计划标签含 bootstrap-context（新会话开场白来源）",
        "bootstrap-context" in tags,
        f"tags={tags}",
    ))
    card_artifact = m2.get("artifact_id")
    revs = _pc_revision_texts(ctx.pc, scope_id, card_artifact)
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "掌握度卡片（t04）revision 历史：盒 1 → 盒 2 轨迹可见",
        len(revs) >= 2 and "盒 1" in revs[0][1] and "盒 2" in revs[-1][1],
        f"{len(revs)} 个 revision：" + "；".join(
            f"rev{r}→{_first_box(t)}" for r, t in revs),
    ))

    # ---- 使用记录：答题事件与会话时长入账，导出无学习者名字 ----
    stats = ctx.app.get(
        f"/api/usage/stats?course_id={COURSE_ID}&source=auto&tz=UTC")
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "使用记录（auto）：本次 3 次答题入账，会话数 ≥ 1",
        (stats.get("quiz_count") or 0) >= 3 and (stats.get("session_count") or 0) >= 1,
        f"答题 {stats.get('quiz_count')} 次，会话 {stats.get('session_count')} 个，"
        f"累计学习时长 {stats.get('study_minutes')} 分钟",
    ))
    export = ctx.app.request(
        "GET", f"/api/usage/export?course_id={COURSE_ID}&source=auto&format=json")
    export_text = export if isinstance(export, str) \
        else json.dumps(export, ensure_ascii=False)
    res.checks.append(Check(
        "使用记录导出（JSON）不含学习者名字（只有 8 位哈希）",
        export is not None and learner not in export_text,
        f"导出 {len(export_text)} 字节，未出现「{learner}」",
    ))

    # ---- 报告正文：题目原文 + PC 读写清单 + revision 历史 ----
    lines = ["复习教练全程（无大模型路径；学习者每次运行都用新名字，"
             "保证首会话 bootstrap 为空）：", ""]
    lines.append(f"- 学习者：{learner}（usage_events 里只有其 sha256 前 8 位哈希）")
    lines.append(f"- 会话 1：{sid1}，3 题（t04 自测答错 → t04 自测答对 → "
                 f"t08 填空答错），1 对；结束后新会话开场白：{opening}")
    lines += ["", "t04（missing）往年原题自测题目原文：", "",
              "```", q1_text, "```", ""]
    lines.append(f"- 出处：{(q1.get('source') or {}).get('label')}")
    lines.append(f"- 提示：{q1.get('hint')}")
    lines += ["", "t08（thin）填空题原文（挖空的是考点词，出处为找到考点词的段落）：",
              "", "```", (q3.get("question") or ""), "```", ""]
    lines.append(f"- 出处：{src3}；正确答案：{a3.get('expected_answer')}（t08 的考点词）")

    lines += ["", "这一路对 PowerContext 的关键读写"
                  "（接口、artifact id、revision、标签；由应用 API 响应与脚本"
                  "直接核对汇总）：", "",
              "| 方向 | 接口 | artifact / 说明 | revision / 标签 |",
              "| --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    mistake1 = a1.get("mistake_memory") or {}
    mistake3 = a3.get("mistake_memory") or {}
    summary = e1.get("summary_memory") or {}
    rw = [
        ("写", "POST /v1/scopes（幂等 key examradar:learner:…）", scope_id, "Scope"),
        ("读", "POST /v1/context/bootstrap（会话 1 开始）", "—（空，第一次复习）", "items=[]"),
        ("读", "POST /v1/context/prepare（t04 出题前）", "—（尚无错题）", "history=[]"),
        ("写", "POST artifacts + PUT tags + PUT handle（t04 掌握度卡片）",
         m1.get("artifact_id"), f"rev {m1.get('revision')}；tags examradar/"
         f"type-mastery/topic-t04"),
        ("写", "POST /v1/memory/remember + PUT tags（t04 错题）",
         mistake1.get("artifact_id"), f"rev {mistake1.get('revision')}；"
         f"tags examradar/type-mistake/topic-t04"),
        ("读", "POST /v1/context/prepare（t04 再出题前）",
         mistake1.get("artifact_id"), f"召回错题 {len(mistake_hist)} 条"),
        ("写", "PUT artifacts（If-Match，t04 卡片）", m2.get("artifact_id"),
         f"rev {m2.get('revision')}（盒 1→2）"),
        ("写", "POST artifacts + tags + handle（t08 掌握度卡片）",
         (a3.get("mastery") or {}).get("artifact_id"),
         f"rev {(a3.get('mastery') or {}).get('revision')}"),
        ("写", "POST /v1/memory/remember + PUT tags（t08 错题）",
         mistake3.get("artifact_id"), f"rev {mistake3.get('revision')}"),
        ("写", "PUT artifacts（If-Match，复习计划）", plan_info.get("artifact_id"),
         f"rev {plan_info.get('revision')}；tags {','.join(tags)}"),
        ("写", "POST /v1/memory/remember + PUT tags（会话小结）",
         summary.get("artifact_id"), f"rev {summary.get('revision')}"),
        ("读", "POST /v1/context/bootstrap（会话 2 开始）",
         plan_info.get("artifact_id"), "开场白 = 计划首行"),
        ("读", "GET artifact-handles / tags / revisions（脚本核对）",
         plan_info.get("artifact_id"), f"handle→rev {plan_info.get('revision')}"),
    ]
    for direction, api, artifact, note in rw:
        lines.append(f"| {direction} | {api} | {artifact} | {note} |")

    lines += ["", f"掌握度卡片（t04，{card_artifact}）revision 历史：", ""]
    for r, text in revs:
        lines.append(f"- rev {r}：{text.splitlines()[0]}")
    if mistake_hist:
        lines += ["", "context/prepare 召回的错题（第 2 题出题前）：", ""]
        for h in mistake_hist[:3]:
            lines.append(f"- {((h.get('text') or '').splitlines() or ['—'])[0]}")
    res.body = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

    ctx.app.post_json("/api/sessions/end", {"session_id": s2.get("session_id")})
    return res


def _first_box(text: str) -> str:
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if "盒" in line:
            return line.strip()
    return text[:40] or "（空）"

# ------------------------------------------------------------- review plan

class TestReviewPlan:
    def test_roundtrip(self):
        text = build_review_plan(ReviewPlanData(
            opening="上次你在『隔离级别与 MVCC』上错了 2 次，先复习它",
            wrong_recent=["t08:2"], due_today=["t03"], blind_missing=["t04"],
            updated="2026-10-28T01:00:00Z"))
        plan = parse_review_plan(text)
        assert plan.opening == "上次你在『隔离级别与 MVCC』上错了 2 次，先复习它"
        assert plan.wrong_recent == ["t08:2"]
        assert plan.due_today == ["t03"]
        assert plan.blind_missing == ["t04"]

    def test_opening_line_parts(self):
        line = build_opening_line(
            wrong_recent=[("t08", "隔离级别与 MVCC", 2)],
            due_today=[("t03", "索引：B+树与哈希索引")],
            blind_missing=[("t04", "函数依赖与范式（3NF、BCNF）", 25.0)])
        assert "上次你在『隔离级别与 MVCC』上错了 2 次，先复习它" in line
        assert "『索引：B+树与哈希索引』今天到期" in line
        assert "『函数依赖与范式（3NF、BCNF）』往年考 25 分但笔记里没有" in line

    def test_opening_line_empty(self):
        assert "复习" in build_opening_line([], [], [])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- session text

class TestSessionSummary:
    def test_summary_contains_stats(self):
        text = format_session_summary(
            12.5, 6, 4, [("t08", "隔离级别与 MVCC", 2)],
            started_at="2026-10-28T01:00:00+00:00")
        assert "12 分钟" in text or "13 分钟" in text
        assert "做题 6 道" in text
        assert "正确率 67%" in text
        assert "隔离级别与 MVCC" in text

    def test_normalize_ignores_whitespace_width_case(self):
        assert normalize_answer(" MVCC ") == normalize_answer("ｍｖｃｃ")
        assert normalize_answer("两阶段 锁") == normalize_answer("两阶段锁")
        assert normalize_answer("ＷＡＬ") == normalize_answer("wal")

    def test_grade_fill(self):
        assert grade_fill("MVCC", " ｍｖｃｃ ")

    def test_grade_choice_exact(self):
        assert grade_choice("A", "A")
        assert not grade_choice("A", "B")
        assert grade_choice("A", "a")

def _ensure_columns(conn, table: str, columns: dict[str, str]):
    """Idempotently add missing columns (MySQL/seekdb has no ADD COLUMN IF
    NOT EXISTS)."""
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            "SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.COLUMNS "
            "WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = %s",
            (table,),
        )
        existing = {r["COLUMN_NAME"] for r in cur.fetchall()}
        for col, ddl in columns.items():
            if col not in existing:
                cur.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {ddl}")

def make_fill_question(topic: dict, chunk: dict,
                       used_terms: Optional[set[str]] = None) -> Optional[dict]:
    """从原文挖空关键术语出填空题，标明出处（文件 · 页 · 标题）。

    used_terms 是本会话这个知识点已经挖过的术语：优先换一个挖空点，
    都挖过了才重复第一个可用的。
    """
    content = chunk.get("content") or ""
    heading = chunk.get("heading")
    candidates = _blank_candidates(topic, content, heading)
    fallback: Optional[dict] = None
    for term in candidates:
        fragment, occurrences = _sentence_with(content, term)
        if occurrences < 1:
            continue
        blanked = fragment.replace(term, "＿＿＿", 1)
        if blanked == fragment:
            continue
        hint = f"（{len(term)} 个字）" if re.search(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]", term) else ""
        source = _chunk_source(chunk)
        q = {
            "question_type": "fill",
            "topic_id": topic["topic_id"],
            "topic_name": topic["topic_name"],
            "question": f"填空：{blanked}{hint}",
            "expected_answer": term,
            "source": source,
            "chunk_id": chunk.get("id"),
            "self_test": False,
            "llm_generated": False,
            "hint": None,
        }
        if fallback is None:
            fallback = q
        if term not in (used_terms or set()):
            return q
    return fallback
